messages:
alex: FYI team — change window opens in ~3h (02:00 UTC). Plan: pin prod to `redwood/v3.3.0-rc2` during the window, canary -> steady rollout. We also have a hard freeze from T-30m to T+30m for non-critical merges. Calling out owners and quick checks below. Speak now if anything blocks.

maria: Acknowledged. I'll own the rollout. Canary target: `canary-zone-b` (8 instances), canary dwell 12m. If canary looks good we'll ramp 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m.

sre: Monitoring knobs: p95 baseline=170ms. Primary rollback triggers I want enforced: error-rate >= 0.8% for 3m OR p95 >= 350ms for 3m. Also watch CPU thermal throttling on the infer nodes during first 5m.

product: Release notes ready but need the short user-facing blurb for the quantized embeddings change + downgrade path note. Will push the blurb in 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: received pin request for `redwood/v3.3.0-rc2` to prod. Scheduling canary to `canary-zone-b` at T+10m. Canary duration: 12m.

alex: Quick checklist before canary starts: 1) smoke:health and smoke:embeddings pass, 2) perf harness baseline run, 3) tracing hooks enabled for rollout, 4) release notes snippet published.

maria: Running smoke jobs when canary starts: `/smoke run canary-zone-b --suite=health,embeddings` 

sre: Note: cold KV cache may cause initial p95 spikes in the first 2 minutes. We'll tolerate a single 1m spike up to 500ms, but sustained >=3m breaches hit rollback.

oncall: I'll be on the watch channel and ready to page. Pager thresholds configured as per sre triggers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated on canary-zone-b (8 instances). Smoke job id `smoke-3527-canary-01`. Perf harness queued: `perf-3527-canary`

maria: Smoke results: health OK, embeddings smoke shows small tokenization warning but no errors. Perf harness shows p95=215ms at minute 2 with a 1m spike to 480ms at minute 1 then settling to 210ms.

sre: Confirming observed spike. Thermal metrics show a brief CPU concurrency bump then normalization. No error-rate increase. Holding through the 12m canary.

product: Published release blurb: "Improved embeddings quantization for lower mem footprint; note: initial requests may be slower during cache warmup. See mitigation: staggered ramp recommended."

alex: Thanks. Rollback playbook posted in #runbooks. Quick commands for record: 
- abort canary: `deploy-bot abort --slice=canary-zone-b`
- rollback to prior stable: `/deploy rollback --to=redwood/v3.2.9-stable`
- emergency stop traffic: `/router set-traffic --all=0`

maria: If canary stays green we'll promote to 25% at T+20m. Owners: maria (rollout), sre (monitoring/rollback), product (notes & comms).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary completed (12m). No sustained threshold breaches. Ready to promote to stage-1 (25%). Proceeding on owner confirmation.

sre: I give the greenlight. No error bump, latency back to ~210ms p95.

maria: Promoting to 25% now. I'll post final promote/rollback confirmations here. Staying on call for 45m after full roll.

oncall: Pager set. If anything trips we'll run `deploy-bot abort` then `/deploy rollback` as needed.

alex: Great work. Reminder: freeze remains until T+30m, only emergency fixes allowed. Post-promote, please update the release notes with any post-launch findings. Starting quiet countdown (T-15m).
